verdict.rationale: Airweave explicitly ingests from apps, databases, and documents (not chat transcripts) into searchable collections, with connectors for sources like Airtable and Bitbucket covering structured business data, files, and code, plus general source connections via API/SDK. Community feedback corroborates it performs RAG-style indexing of copied data rather than being a chat-log tool. Missing for 10: explicit named connector for raw JSON ingestion and independent benchmarking of document/structured-data fidelity beyond vendor docs.
